body.name: coupled score-lifting handle
body.construction: Linearize the joint outcome-solvability, treatment-solvability, and moving-rank maps; quotient their derivative by \(\mathcal N_a(P)\) and \(\mathcal K_a(P)\); orthogonalize the two arms' derivative equations against the shared \((W,X)\) marginal; and use closed-range right inverses plus finite-support chart localization to synthesize path-score approximants for a target element of \(\mathcal C_P^\perp\).
